addGlobalAppsReference.name: Add Global Instances
addGlobalAppsReference.hint: (v13+) This adds a global variable named "apps" that allows you to access "foundry.applications.instances" with less typing.

addGlobalDocReferrer.name: Add Global "_doc"
addGlobalDocReferrer.hint: (v13+) This adds a header control to document sheets that sets the _doc globalThis variable. Until the header control is triggered, the "_doc" variable is undefined.

autoUnpauseOnLoad.name: Auto Unpause On Load
autoUnpauseOnLoad.hint: (v13+, GM-Only) Automatically unpauses the game when you load into the world. This will happen EVERY time you load into the world, including if you reload the website.

chatImageLinks.name: Image Shortcuts
chatImageLinks.hint: (v13+) Automatically embeds image and gif links when posted in the chat. The link must point to a specific image file (e.g. png, webp, gif), otherwise it will not be embedded at all.

chatSidebarBackground.name: Chat Background
chatSidebarBackground.hint: (v13+) Adds a background to the chat tab of the right-hand sidebar.

defaultHotbarPage.name: Default Hotbar Page
defaultHotbarPage.hint: (v13+) What page the hotbar will default to when loading into Foundry.

hideProseMirrorChatMenu.name: Hide Chat Text Menu
hideProseMirrorChatMenu.hint: (v14+) Hides the rich-text menu controls in the chat sidebar. This does not disable any keybinds used to style your chat message, it just hides the menu.

hotbarButtonGap.name: Hotbar Button Gap
hotbarButtonGap.hint: (v13+) Allows changing the amount of space between the hotbar buttons.

hotbarButtonSize.name: Hotbar Button Size
hotbarButtonSize.hint: (v13+) Changes the size of the hotbar buttons to a size you prefer.

preventMovementHistory.name: Prevent Movement History
preventMovementHistory.hint: (v13+, GM-Only) This prevents Foundry from recording movement history of a token, but not disabling the movement ruler.

preventTokenRotation.name: Prevent Token Auto-Rotation
preventTokenRotation.hint: (v13+, GM-Only) This prevents tokens from rotating while you are moving them allowing you to more easily use POG-style tokens without them being rotated automatically by Foundry.

preventUserConfigOpen.name: Prevent Auto User Config
preventUserConfigOpen.hint: (v13+, Non-GMs) Prevents Foundry from opening the User Configuration when a player loads into the world.

repositionHotbar.name: Reposition Hotbar
repositionHotbar.hint: (v13+) This moves the hotbar into a position similar to where it was in ~v11, making it so that it doesn't move when you expand or collapse the right-hand sidebar.

startSidebarExpanded.name: Start Sidebar Expanded
startSidebarExpanded.hint: (v13+) Starts the right-hand sidebar expanded when logging in.

startingSidebarTab.name: Starting Sidebar Tab
startingSidebarTab.hint: (v13+) Determines what sidebar tab to have selected initially when loading Foundry.

customStatusIcons.name: Custom Status Icons
customStatusIcons.hint: (v13+) Modify your token status effect icons without needing a custom module or a world script to do so! Pick any image on your server for the icons!
customStatusIcons.label: Configure Icons

devSettings.name: Developer Settings
devSettings.hint: Tweaks that are relevant if you are developing something within Foundry, but are rarely useful outside of that context.
devSettings.label: Configure Dev Settings

rearrangeSidebarTabs.name: Rearrange Sidebar Tabs
rearrangeSidebarTabs.hint: (v13+) Allows you to customize the order the right-hand sidebar tabs appear in. Including module-added sidebar tabs.
rearrangeSidebarTabs.label: Change Tab Order

toggleMouseBroadcast.name: Toggle Show Cursor
toggleMouseBroadcast.hint: (v13+) Temporarily turns off the mouse cursor position that other players can see. Hides the cursor until you activate this keybind again.

StatusEffectIconConfig.title: Configure Status Effect Icons
StatusEffectIconConfig.no-status-effects: No status effects detected, this is most likely due to your game system or other modules.

SidebarTabRearranger.title: Rearrange Sidebar Tabs
SidebarTabRearranger.user-override-warning: You have a User-level tab order, saving any changes to the World-level tab order will not show up for you.
